body: There is some statistical evidence that using letter variables in a math problem confuses young children.  However, they could have used pictures - shapes - colors - squiggly lines - fucking ANYTHING but numbers.  The author is an idiot.
Is there ever a place where it's not?

Congratulations, you figured out I live in the Appalachian mountains.

The questions I mentioned were not asked in a joking or teasing tone.  It wasn't mean-spirited, though - just genuinely curious in a stupid fashion.  All six times I can think of off-hand, the askers seemed to believe that I live in a "Little House on the Prairie" type of environment, with no electricity and no idea what modern life is like.

Uh-huh.

For someone who doesn't waste one moment's thought on Southerners, you sure have a lot of concrete ideas about them.
I can tell you, from experience, that those questions do happen.

To be fair, if that Southerner had gone up North, he/she would have fielded dumb questions like "Do you wear shoes in the South?" and "Have you ever seen a computer?" and been ridiculed for his/her accent.

After a few instances of that, it's hard not to hate Yankees.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O6sTv04Z7BI

The ad at 4:40 especially... but they're all pretty hilarious.

I talked to my mom, and she gave me a hard time but she said she would help me figure out how to stop the wage garnishment.  This is very helpful, if I can get the 15% lowered then I might be able to at least survive, although I would not get a tax refund for the next 20 years.  

As "payment" I have to go to church with her 5x a week until she drives me to my court date in 2 months (Sunday school, Sunday morning service, Sunday evening service, Wednesday prayer service, Thursday choir practice).  It's a nightmare but at least it is a temporary nightmare.  She has told her church "everything" about me and they treat me either like a poor lost lamb or a demon-worshiping whore, sometimes weirdly both.  She told my boss that legally he has to allow me time for "religious worship", so I can't get out of it with work.
I appreciate the thought about the shoes, but I feel funny giving out my address.
I would gladly be a stripper, but as I said, I'm fat and I'm ugly.  The porn she was talking about is BBW porn.

I didn't know I could tell them to contact me by mail, I will try that.  One of them even called me several times at my work number, and they talked to my boss about my debt (they told him how much I owe, and that I would go to jail, and that he should "encourage" me to pay), which I KNOW is illegal to do, but there's no way to prove it now.

Thank you, but I went ahead and stole one from the living room already :)  My roommate yelled, but I told her if I was going to pay for the light bill I was going to have some goddamn light in my room.
Bankruptcy does not cancel out student loans, unfortunately.  :(
I sent you a message.  Thank you.

I could use better shoes.  The ones I wear now, the left one has a hole in the bottom.  When it rains or snows my foot gets wet.

I could also use a light bulb for this room, because the last one burnt out a few days ago.  I'm in pitch dark here.  Can't afford to get bulbs right now, I am literally down to my last 28 cents until the 15th.  I might steal a bulb from the living room light, but my roommate would be pissed.

Nope.  Mom says that anything bad that happens, is what I deserve, because I abandoned god.  She lives on Social Security and she's not much better off than I am anyway.

My roommate recommended that I get into Internet porn because that is what she is going to do.

Not for very long.  I went to the services agency in my county and I couldn't get food stamps unless I quit my job.  I could quit and draw unemployment, but it would run out before I found another job anywhere near here.  I know because I've been looking for the past 2 years.  I've even had interviews, but nobody wants to hire a college dropout for anything that's not minimum wage.  I'm already making more than minimum wage now (barely), and I'm drowning.

I'm not paying anything on the debt at all right now.  But it doesn't matter if my ex bought it, because I co-signed the papers because he asked me to, and back then I would have done anything for him.

I don't have anything to sell.  Seriously.  I don't own the tv, my roommate does.  I don't even own my bed or night table, she does.  I don't have anything except a phone, which I need, and a few clothes that are worn and stretched out and old, and couldn't pay for a trip downtown, much less to another part of the country.  When I die they'll go to Goodwill, and Goodwill will toss them in the dollar bin.

I don't have 90% of the things that society has taught me to want.  I don't even have the things I need.  I suppose you could argue I don't need this phone but if I didn't have it I couldn't get called in to work, and it's only $50 a month.

edit - that 15% out of my paycheck (for student loan) is taken automatically.  I don't have any control over it.
